scope: Corrected, source-pinned recipe for the H217 scratch TCN and a same-recipe raw GRU256x2 comparator. No GPU profile, fit, export, public call, or score was run while freezing this file.
hypothesis: A 12-block causal raw TCN may supply a useful teacher view at smaller channel width than the raw GRU384 teachers; the matching seed-7 GRU256x2 control estimates family-specific behavior under the same target/split/optimizer recipe. Standalone score and conditional teacher/blend value are separate questions.

basis.decision: Review FAIL is resolved narrowly in this successor: profile evidence now includes attempts/completions/AMP skips/loss finiteness and rejects unusable profiles; TCN argv omits ignored --cell gru. The candidate itself remains immutable.

comparison_design.primary_candidate: raw-only causal TCN, C128/L12, mix=1, seed7, fold0 exclusion, WMSE/chunk, 4 epochs, fixed epoch3.
comparison_design.matched_control: raw-only GRU256x2, seed7, same split, target, optimizer, schedule, precision, batch choice, epoch count and checkpoint epoch.
comparison_design.matching_limit: Recipe matched on training treatment and seed, but TCN and GRU are not parameter-matched or compute-matched. Record parameter count, measured step wall, throughput and memory separately; do not label this as a compute-controlled family comparison.
comparison_design.training_ancestry: Both train from independent initialization. No E521 checkpoint initialization, distillation, propensity weighting, auxiliary objective, teammate weights, or teacher ancestry.
comparison_design.evaluation: Fold0 was previously exposed. Use fixed epoch3 train/valid exports for standalone and conditional teacher-usefulness analysis; this is development evidence, never a fresh holdout or public forecast.

tcn.view: raw-only replaces event channels with zeros; input ABI stays 211 wide.

resource_caps.admission_note: These are explicit ceilings/reservations for a future root-owned admission. No attempt is authorized by this recipe. Preserve aggregate 6 CPU/20 GB RAM/5 GB observed VRAM; run one GPU job at a time.

fit_branches.selection_gate: B8 is first for both families. B16 is conditional on complete B8 receipts, measured activation/model-state decomposition, a conservative 20% headroom estimate inside both the 4.3 GB allocator and 5 GB whole-device limits, and current cgroup/RAM headroom. Fit both at the same selected batch. If B16 is not safe for either arm, use the B8 pair or defer; do not compare different fit batches as though otherwise matched.

profile_acceptance: Require the PROFILE_UPDATE_EVIDENCE JSON line: attempts > 0; attempts = completed + AMP-skipped; loss_checks = attempts; finite losses true; gradient_finite true (GradScaler found-inf flags after unscale); valid_for_throughput true. A nonzero exit with serialized evidence is a failed profile, not a measured successful profile. Keep observed/reserved VRAM, RSS/cgroup peak, OOM deltas and phase timings with the receipt.

profile_gate: Admit both B8 profiles first. Consider B16 only after both B8 receipts have complete finite-update evidence and report usable activation/model-state and allocated/reserved memory. Require a conservative 20% headroom estimate within the 4.3 GB CUDA allocator cap and 5 GB whole-device observed ceiling, plus current RAM/cgroup headroom inside the 6.5 GB worker cap; no OOM deltas. A measured B8 pass never auto-admits B16.
